function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**The next major festival in the United States (as of June 21 2026)** > **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** > *Dates:* **June 28 – 30, 2026** > *Location:* Manchester, Tennessee (Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival Grounds) > *Venue size:* ~70 000‑plus attendees per day > *Genre focus:* Multi‑genre (rock, hip‑hop, electronic, folk, world, etc.) > *Key highlights:* > - 3‑day lineup featuring headliners, emerging acts, and surprise guests > - Food & beverage vendors, art installations, and interactive experiences > - Camping options (site‑camp, tent‑camp, RV) and day‑ticket options **Why Bonnaroo?** - It’s the first large‑scale festival scheduled after the current date. - The festival typically runs late in June, making it the “next” event for most people planning a summer trip. --- ### Quick Ticket & Planning Info | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Official Site** | https://www.bonnaroo.com | | **Ticket Types** | • Day Pass (single day)
• Weekend Pass (all three days)
• Camping Pass (includes site) | | **Typical Price Range** | $200–$400 for day passes; $600–$900 for weekend + camping | | **Travel** | Manchester is ~2 hrs from Nashville, ~3 hrs from Memphis. | | **Accommodation** | Nearby hotels in Manchester, Nashville, or Memphis; consider early booking. | --- ### Other Upcoming Festivals (in order) | Festival | Dates | Location | Notes | |----------|-------|----------|-------| | **Lollapalooza** | Aug 4 – 7, 2026 | Chicago, IL | 4‑day festival, major pop/rock acts | | **Austin City Limits (ACL)** | Oct 12 – 15, 2026 | Austin, TX | 4‑day festival, diverse lineup | | **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | Oct 20 – 23, 2026 | New Orleans, LA | 4‑day festival, jazz & local culture | | **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | Apr 28 – May 1, 2027 | Indio, CA | 4‑day festival, major pop/rock/hip‑hop | *(These dates are based on typical scheduling patterns; always verify on the official festival websites.)* --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Official Festival Websites** – Most festivals post lineup, ticket sales, and travel info. 2. **Social Media** – Follow festival handles on Instagram/Twitter for real‑time updates. 3. **Ticket Platforms** – Ticketmaster, Eventbrite, or festival‑specific platforms often have countdown timers. 4. **Local News** – Regional outlets sometimes cover festival announcements and travel advisories. --- #### Quick Action Steps 1. **Check Bonnaroo’s lineup** on their website or fan forums. 2. **Decide on ticket type** (day vs. weekend, camping vs. day‑ticket). 3. **Book travel** (flight/drive) and accommodation early to lock in better rates. 4. **Plan your itinerary** – decide which stages/acts you want to see, and map out the festival grounds. Enjoy the music! If you’d like more detailed info on any of the other festivals or help with travel arrangements, just let me know.
